digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation; transition close gate
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, when in fact it accepts any commit (merged or local) reachable from current HEAD's history.

The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being on, not unconditional as documented; it also exits early on --force-close or a live duplicate/supersedes replacement link.

The precheck accepts a referencing commit for the ticket or any transitive descendant (not just the ticket itself), as accepted_ids includes all descendants from list_descendants across epic/story/task/bug buckets.

The rebar transition --ref flag, documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md, is omitted from AGENTS.md; it enables closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by policy (Verified +1 rule), not by the precheck mechanism, and this causal relationship is misstated in both files.
The --ref flag retargets only completion verification and signature to a given ref's tree; it does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, which runs git log with no ref regardless of --ref.
